name: triply
description: TRIPLY — Plan together. Discover together. Travel together. Collaborative social travel planning (Next.js + NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @triply/shared" "npm run dev -w @triply/api" "npm run dev -w @triply/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @triply/shared && npm run db:generate -w @triply/api && npm run build -w @triply/api && npm run build -w @triply/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @triply/api" "npm run start -w @triply/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @triply/shared && npm run typecheck -w @triply/api && npm run typecheck -w @triply/web
